1.web: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
1.asv: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.

2.web: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
2.asv: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovahendurethfor ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
